2068.problem: Implement a traffic-light encoding for a dashboard: given a list of `{"metric": m, "value": v, "target": t}` dicts, color each metric green if `value >= target`, yellow if within 10% below target, and red if more than 10% below target, using `makeColor`.
2068.answer:
func trafficLightEncoding(metrics) = {
  metrics.map { m ->
    local v = m.get("value")
    local t = m.get("target")
    local c = #FF0000
    if (v >= t) c = #00FF00
    else if (v >= t * 0.9) c = #FFFF00
    local nm = copyDict(m)
    nm.set("color", c)
    nm
  }
}
